messages:
Zoe: EY asked for KMS rotation chain-of-custody + RBAC change log for the past 120 days. Also asked how we redact PII in artifacts. Need to send by EOD tomorrow.
Carlos: We can export CloudTrail events (RotateKey, UpdateKeyPolicy, CreateGrant), git commits for infra/kms, and IAM + k8s rolebinding diffs. We'll produce an artifacts bundle + manifest with sha256s.
Auditor_EY: Prefer machine-readable CSV/JSON. For each rotation we need: timestamp, approver (pseudonym ok), triggering ticket, and post-rotation verification evidence. Role ARNs are fine; redact emails.
Zoe: Plan: 1) cloudtrail_rotate_120d.json (API events) 2) kms-policy-commits.log + kms-policy-diff.patch 3) roles_kms_snapshot.csv (principals with kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) 4) irsa_mapping.csv 5) redaction_map.csv + manifest.csv. Link all in a single tar.gz. SOP pointer: docs/security/kms-rotation.md.
Carlos: CLI snippets I used: 
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-12-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-31T00:00:00Z > cloudtrail_rotate_120d.json
git log --pretty=format:'%H %an %ad %s' -- infra/kms-policies/ --since='2025-12-01' --until='2026-03-31' > kms-policy-commits.log
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, .subjects] | @json' > k8s_rbac_raw.json
Zoe: Auditor asked about grant lifetimes and temporary grants used for backup access. We should include grants.csv with create/delete timestamps and grantId.
Carlos: FYI there was an emergency rotation for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:emer-77 on 2026-02-14 after CVE-2026-7777 was triaged (ticket SEC-777). Post-rotation smoke-test logs: smoke_decrypt_20260214.log show successful decrypts.
Auditor_EY: Include the incident ticket and a short narrative (150-300 chars) per rotation explaining trigger, approver pseudonym, and verification steps. Also annotate any changes in which principals could decrypt (before/after diff).
Zoe: ops: evidence_bot start bundle job with tags [kms, rbac, soc2]. Include redaction policy: replace personal emails with employee:<id>. We'll deliver identity mapping via secure SFTP per auditor request.
evidence_bot: job-1759991111 started. ETA ~4m. :package: 
Carlos: Manifest sample row: 
artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
cloudtrail,aws,2026-02-14T09:12:03Z,cloudtrail_rotate_20260214.json,9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d,true
Zoe: Also add a short SOP excerpt as sop_excerpt.txt showing who can approve emergency rotations and where approvals are recorded (JIRA comments + approver id).
Auditor_EY: Received bundle link when ready. We'll validate and may request a short walkthrough on the IRSA mapping for service "data-exporter".
Carlos: I can join a quick call tomorrow 11:00-11:30 PT. Once evidence_bot posts link I'll draft the cover message.
Zoe: Thanks all. Will finalize redaction_map and send SFTP instructions for identity mapping after bundle is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
